test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

M & N means ‘M is the son of N’,

M @ N means ‘M is the brother of N’,

M $ N means ‘M is the father of N’,

M # N means ‘ M is the mother of N’.

Based on this, how is E related to A, if ‘A # B $ C @ D & E’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 &
 @
 #
 $
 
 

 Meaning
 Son
 Brother
 Mother
 Father
 
 

 

Given: A # B $ C @ D & E

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/129ad5f14a2cf16c0852a19bdd813cfcab8df8c82ca87a79e4bc8f01e3327d34.png] 

It means: A is the mother of B, B is the father of C, C is the brother of D and D is the son of E.

So, E is the '**Son’s wife**' of A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
